create_circos_instance: create a Circos instance with named sectors and configurable degree ranges and spacing
build_chord_diagram: build a chord diagram visualization from a matrix file or DataFrame with custom colors and links
create_radar_chart: create a radar chart from a table file or DataFrame with grid lines, markers, and fill colors
build_phylogenetic_tree: build a Circos visualization from a phylogenetic tree in newick or nexus format
create_circos_from_bed: create a Circos instance with sectors defined from a BED file of chromosome regions
